_readme: Optional details for cards whose art lives in public/cards. Keys are card ids (the file name without its _X suffix, lower-case, dashes). Every field is optional: name, kind (beast | character), domain, symbol, flavor, power, rarity.

abyss-shark.flavor: Hunts in depths no number line reaches.

angry-alex.flavor: Has a bone to pick with every wrong answer.

axel-the-axolotl.flavor: Regrows a limb for every proof it loses.

clean-capybara.flavor: Tidies every equation it sits on.

desert-griffo.flavor: Circles the dunes in perfect arcs.

oriel-the-absolute.flavor: Sees the end of every sequence at once.

scary-steve.flavor: The odds are never in your favour.

sleepy-fox.flavor: Counts sheep. Loses count. Starts again.
